SNDK.notes: The Item 7 excerpt only repeats the Item 1 overview paragraph and has no community, education, small-business, artist or accessibility content. Several terms were excluded as traps: Flash Ventures and Unis Venture 'joint ventures' and 'collaboration' (legal structures and licensing), 'chip-level design' and 'memory design' (engineering), 'licensing' of patents and technology, 'diversified product portfolio', 82% international sales and 33-country presence, the regional headcount split (demographics only), annual ethics and compliance training, and health and safety training. BE@Sandisk communities reflect 'identities, interests, and aspirations', so they may be partly interest-based rather than identity-based; level 2 was kept as the conservative reading. On Entrepreneurship, the trap list excludes 'innovation' as qualifying evidence, while the level-1 ladder explicitly covers the company's own innovation; 1 was assigned because the ladder defines it, and no enabling activity exists.
